name: roadies-rebirth
description: Unofficial fan site for Roadies Rebirth (MERN stack)

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix server install
